title: achillea ceretanica
intro: Achillea ceretanica, commonly known as the Alpine Yarrow, is a flowering plant species that belongs to the Asteraceae family. This plant is known for its health benefits, particularly in treating digestive issues, such as bloating, and menstrual cramps due to its anti-inflammatory and antispasmodic properties. The therapeutic actions of Achillea ceretanica include its ability to reduce pain and inflammation, as well as its antimicrobial and antifungal properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and volatile oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
